applicability.expression_language: allowlisted conjunction of == comparisons on encounter.kind and the FR-21 effect status only; no arithmetic, no function calls, no note access (proposed for owner review; the S25 allowlist parser is authoritative)
required_fields: absence of conflicting values for mapped nodes
applicability.unknown_policy: effect absent yields not_applicable with reason (no inference, no CPTs, no posterior; a false gate is never a negative posterior). Effect not_assessed, missing, or conflicting yields needs_clarification and stops later questions; saving corrected input creates a new run. Missing required severity when present yields needs_clarification. Missing optional input (every proposed parkinsonism_assessment field and the structured-history prior mapping) leaves that node as unknown_incomplete; inference proceeds and the template renders an unknown disclosure.

context_output_resource_limits.note: Limits are proposed engineering ceilings for review; final values set after measuring admitted models per plan 8.3. Full-CPT payload must fit or admission is rejected; no silent truncation.

cpt_contract.row_order: child state fastest; last declared parent next; first parent slowest
cpt_contract.validation: one table per node in declared order; exact node/parent/state identity and order; no extra fields; finite numbers in [0,100]; each row sums to 100 within 1e-6; reject missing/duplicate/extra rows, strings/booleans/null, nonfinite, out-of-range, wrong sums; never normalize/clip/repair

engine_configuration.elimination_order: deterministic pinned order with deterministic tie-breaking
engine_configuration.note: Pinned engine/runtime recorded at admission in S39; replay reads stored effective CPTs/evidence/query without provider calls.

impossible_evidence_policy: fail with explicit error; never soften or approximate. All declared states (including unknown_incomplete where declared) are possible, so impossibility arises only from schema violations (undeclared node/state, conflicting evidence on one node).

patient_mappings.missing_policy: effect absent is handled at the gate (not_applicable), not here. Effect present with missing severity, or missing effect record, yields needs_clarification (blocks).
patient_mappings.time_window: current_encounter; clinician rating recorded with actor and timestamp per the runtime value envelope
patient_mappings.typed_transform: signs_without_documented_functional_limitation iff effect status present AND severity signs_without_documented_functional_limitation; functional_limitation_or_falls iff present AND severity functional_limitation_or_falls; severe_or_urgent_features iff present AND severity severe_or_urgent_features. Present-without-severity is required-missing (needs_clarification), never defaulted. No SAS mild/moderate/severe bands and no SAS total/mean threshold is ever mapped.

patient_mappings.missing_policy: field absent yields unknown_incomplete with disclosure until the field is reviewed and collected (permits inference; renders assess_differential_and_association).
patient_mappings.time_window: current_encounter for the assessment; historical_interval for onset dates and pre-exposure symptoms where recorded
patient_mappings.typed_transform: antipsychotic_associated_assessed iff clinician records parkinsonism associated with antipsychotic exposure after onset/medication-change review with no unresolved alternative (Parkinson disease, other neurology, catatonia, negative symptoms, depressive slowing, unmasking); alternative_or_unresolved iff an alternative explanation is recorded or recovery is delayed pending reassessment; else unknown_incomplete. Never inferred from severity, medication presence, any SAS value, or page notes.

patient_mappings.missing_policy: field absent yields unknown_incomplete with disclosure until reviewed and collected (permits inference).
patient_mappings.typed_transform: yes iff clinician records dose reduction feasible (presence only; no milligrams, no regimen numbers, no automatic action); no iff clinician records not feasible; else unknown_incomplete.

patient_mappings.missing_policy: field absent yields unknown_incomplete with disclosure until reviewed and collected (permits inference).
patient_mappings.typed_transform: yes iff clinician records switching to a lower-parkinsonism-propensity antipsychotic feasible with candidate review; no iff not feasible; else unknown_incomplete. No product choice is encoded.

patient_mappings.missing_policy: field absent yields unknown_incomplete with disclosure until reviewed and collected (permits inference; routes to prioritize_psychosis_tradeoff, never to silent dose/switch review).
patient_mappings.typed_transform: present iff patient-specific concern about psychotic worsening with dose reduction or switching is recorded; absent_assessed iff clinician records no such concern (absent is not zero risk); else unknown_incomplete.

patient_mappings.missing_policy: field absent yields unknown_incomplete with disclosure until reviewed and collected (permits inference).
patient_mappings.typed_transform: present iff patient expresses concern or reluctance about symptomatic medication, including bother from anticholinergic effects; absent_assessed iff clinician records none (absent does not establish consent); else unknown_incomplete.

patient_mappings.missing_policy: field absent yields unknown_incomplete with disclosure until reviewed and collected (permits inference; any unknown routes to enhanced review, never to routine reassurance).
patient_mappings.typed_transform: present iff an assessed cognitive, urinary, bowel, ocular, cardiac, thermoregulatory or other anticholinergic safety concern is recorded; absent_assessed iff clinician records none; else unknown_incomplete.

patient_mappings.missing_policy: field absent yields unknown_incomplete with disclosure until reviewed and collected (permits inference).
patient_mappings.typed_transform: present iff clinician assesses older-age vulnerability; absent_assessed iff clinician records none. No invented age cutoff is used; never derived from the reported age integer alone.

allowed_source_paths: encounters.draft_data.medications (reconciled drug identities only, FR-14 drug-only context)
patient_mappings.missing_policy: field absent yields unknown_incomplete with disclosure until reviewed and collected (permits inference).
patient_mappings.typed_transform: present iff clinically relevant anticholinergic burden from concomitant medications (excluding the target parkinsonism treatment) is recorded; absent_assessed iff clinician records none; else unknown_incomplete. Drug identities only; no dose, route, or regimen inference.

allowed_source_paths: encounters.draft_data.medications (reconciled drug identities only, FR-14 drug-only context)
patient_mappings.missing_policy: field absent yields unknown_incomplete with disclosure until reviewed and collected (permits inference; renders reassess_need_and_differential).
patient_mappings.typed_transform: yes iff a current anticholinergic medication specifically used for parkinsonism is recorded; no iff clinician records none; else unknown_incomplete.

patient_mappings.missing_policy: field absent yields unknown_incomplete with disclosure until reviewed and collected (permits inference; prior history is illustrative prophylaxis context only).
patient_mappings.time_window: historical_interval for the prior episode; current_encounter for the mapping assessment
patient_mappings.typed_transform: yes iff assessed history of significant parkinsonism with prior treatment is recorded; no iff clinician records none; else unknown_incomplete. Never authorizes prophylaxis on its own.

patient_mappings.missing_policy: field absent yields unknown_incomplete with disclosure until reviewed and collected (permits inference; routes to review_specific_safety_concerns, never to silent alternative discussion).
patient_mappings.typed_transform: present iff clinician concern is recorded (renal impairment, hallucinations, suicidal thoughts, seizure disorder, tolerability); absent_assessed iff clinician records none; else unknown_incomplete. Details require current product-label review.

allowed_source_paths: encounters.draft_data.parkinsonism_assessment.tardive_dyskinesia_concern (PROPOSED, not collected; distinct from the F1 effect status, never auto-read from another question)
patient_mappings.missing_policy: field absent yields unknown_incomplete with disclosure until reviewed and collected (permits inference; routes to review_tardive_differential, never to silent anticholinergic discussion).
patient_mappings.typed_transform: present iff assessed possible or coexisting tardive dyskinesia is recorded; absent_assessed iff clinician records none; else unknown_incomplete. Anticholinergics can worsen TD.

reviewed_result_mapping: posterior branches rendered as review prompts only; maximum posterior is not a recommendation rule; deterministic urgent flag from saved severity shown first and never waits for LLM; all seven posteriors always rendered alongside the indication branch; unknown_disclosure always appended; needs_clarification branch on required missing/conflict; not_applicable branch on gate-absent
